name: Smoked Salmon & Goat Cheese on Toasted Rolls with "Everything" Spice
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
When the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallots and cook, stirring often, until softened, 2-3 minutes.

Add garlic, seeds, salt, and pepper to the skillet with the shallots. Continue to cook, stirring often, until the shallots and garlic become golden, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl to keep the garlic from overcooking.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes. Thinly slice and transfer to a plate.
Trim off and discard ends of the cucumber; slice crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the plate.
Slice tomato into rounds and add to the plate. Season veggies with salt and pepper.
Combine goat cheese and yogurt in a medium bowl and mash with a fork until smooth and creamy.
Spread goat cheese mixture over toasted rolls. Layer with smoked salmon, cucumber, tomato, radish, and capers.
To serve, divide between plates and top with "Everything" spice. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
